description: Look up a county or comparable administrative area by code or name, with nullable ISO 3166-2 iso_code. Paid plans include area, population and seat automatically. Pass state to resolve a colliding name. Property_tax contains annual_median, currency and period: median annual tax payable on owner-occupied homes in the area, adjusted to the final year of that period. It is not a rate or property bill. Unsupported, missing and censored estimates are null.

code.description: County code or name, e.g. 37081, guilford county

country.description: ISO2, ISO3, or a country name. Optional when the lookup is unique.

deep.description: Compatibility flag; paid plans include this profile detail automatically.

lang.description: Optional display language, such as fr or zh-Hant. IDs, numeric values and input parsing stay unchanged.

state.description: ADM1 code or name to disambiguate, e.g. NC or louisiana

name: county
title: County
